nodes.label: lego-solver subagent (Sonnet)
nodes.rationale: Read-only fixer for one failed check (floating, collisions, connected, inventory); may inspect the build with short Python but does not edit files; keeps plan shape and colors, changes as little as possible.

nodes.label: Solver answer format (cause, exact edits, inventory confirmation)
nodes.rationale: Answer is one-line cause, copyable build.py edits (e.g. replace line 42 / add bl.Element after line 57), and confirmation the owned inventory covers the edits, so the builder can apply them verbatim.
